register.labelZh: BURN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: burn away 可以表示某物的一部分逐漸燒掉;burn up 則表示某物完全燒毀。；火可以 burn down,表示火勢逐漸減弱;也可以 burn out,表示火完全熄滅。；你可以使用 BURN 片語動詞描述建築物、房間、車輛、油漆和機器受到的損壞。；burn out 可以表示一個人因過度勞累而身心耗盡;burn somebody up 則可以表示令某人非常生氣。
register.summaryEn: Burn away can describe part of something slowly disappearing, while burn up describes complete destruction. A fire can burn down and become smaller, or burn out and stop completely. You can use BURN expressions to describe damage to buildings, rooms, vehicles, paint and machines. Burn out can describe becoming completely exhausted, while burn somebody up can describe making someone very angry.
